title: grounded knowledge internalization and removable replay

claim.to_prove: Taiji can convert repeated, grounded Workbench outcomes into replayable native features or traces, preserve old abilities, and remove an external description only after causal evidence and checkpoint recovery pass.
must_not_claim: Internalized knowledge is not an execution channel, an executor, or an MCP capability.
Internalization is not automatic general intelligence or full retraining from scratch.
A provider response, prompt, or capability name alone is not a grounded learning example.

forbidden_input: a capability_id used to fabricate an affordance
a single demonstration as proof of internalization

output.type: versioned grounded feature example and internalization lifecycle record
output.update_rule: Only the Taiji-owned converter and learner may create or update feature content; runtime and provider layers may supply evidence but cannot assign internalized status.

trace.provenance: Link every feature or trace to its real outcome, affordance, capability snapshot, parent/child checkpoint lineage, manifest revision, and lifecycle decision.
trace.determinism: The same parent checkpoint, manifest, evidence digest, seed, and replay budget produce the same example IDs, feature digest, and lifecycle decisions.

resources.budget_owner: Taiji learning budget and bounded replay policy

checkpoint.trial_rule: Save a parent and trial checkpoint before learner mutation; an in-memory feature does not qualify as internalized.
checkpoint.continuation: After restore, the next update preserves replay partitions, lineage, counters, and tombstones and cannot resurrect rejected content.

layers.kind: pure DTO conversion and deterministic replay
native learner with checkpoint, holdout, and lesions

red_proof: missing grounding creates no learnable example
holdout labels or provider text cannot enter replay
duplicate evidence cannot inflate the update budget
affordance or feature lesion removes the claimed benefit
knowledge cannot be marked internalized before causal evidence
external description cannot be deleted before the five-lesion recovery Gate
checkpoint restore cannot resurrect rejected or tombstoned content
evidence.holdout: Holdout tasks and future outcomes remain read-only and are not used to create, select, or tune replay examples.
evidence.lesion: Disable the learned feature/trace, grounding source, or external description separately; the corresponding benefit and dependency must change as predicted.
evidence.cross_seed: Admit internalized content only when gain, retention, grounding sensitivity, and resource trade-offs replicate across independent seeds and task slices.

failure_isolation.conversion_failure: Reject the example and keep the parent learner state unchanged; retain the reason and evidence digest.
failure_isolation.learner_failure: Restore the parent checkpoint, return unused budget, and leave the external description active.
failure_isolation.deletion_failure: Abort physical deletion; tombstone only the attempted lifecycle transition and retain the source artifact.

rollback.path: restore parent checkpoint, reverse replay/feature budget, mark the child lifecycle rolled_back, and retain tombstone evidence
rollback.atomicity: Feature state, replay partition, lifecycle status, budget, and checkpoint lineage commit atomically.
rollback.recovery: A rolled-back example requires fresh grounded evidence and a new example ID before reconsideration.

implementation.s0_scope: pure DTO conversion, content addressing, train-only deduplicated replay, lifecycle and checkpoint roundtrip
implementation.s1_scope: atomic native consolidation trial, parent/child checkpoint lineage, read-only holdout/retention evaluation, and internalized/grounding lesions
implementation.s2_projection: api/seed_runtime.py projects only current, verified read-only Workbench evidence plus its re-projected grounded successor affordance into GroundedOutcomeEvidence; runtime cannot write replay, train, or advance lifecycle status.
implementation.next_stage: S2-B real Workbench longitudinal holdout, lesions, checkpoint recovery, and deletion-candidate Gate

boundary: Knowledge descriptions, feature traces, and replay examples may become removable only through an explicit, recoverable lifecycle.
Real Workbench executors, MCP channels, capability registration, policy, and side-effect permissions are never internalized into a deletable cognition artifact.
R5A supplies evidence to R5C structural growth but does not itself add neurons, regions, or execution capabilities.
dependencies: W7-R5B effector registry for capability snapshot freshness
W7-R5C structural growth only after R5A evidence passes
replaces: knowledge and execution capability in one lifecycle
